Definition: Mikajah, the name of an Israelite and an Israelitess
BiblicalUsage: Michaiah is the name of a queen mother, the daughter of Uriel, and also of a prince Jehoshaphat sends out to teach the law in the cities of Judah. The two bearers could hardly be more different — one stands beside a king, the other carries God's teaching into the towns.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that God uses both stations: a name can sit on a throne and walk a teaching road, and neither place is wasted.
